subject: general
question: How many languages are included in the Indo-Aryan language family as per Family-Wise Grouping of The 122 Scheduled and Non-Scheduled Languages - 2001?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **21** languages are included in the Indo-Aryan language family as per the Family-Wise Grouping of the **122 Scheduled and Non-Scheduled Languages - 2001**.
 
• The Indo-Aryan languages constitute a major language family of South Asia and form a subgroup of the Indo-Iranian branch of the Indo-European languages.
 
• Languages such as Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, and Gujarati are part of the Indo-Aryan language family.
 
• This language family is the largest in India in terms of the number of speakers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **census of 2001** provided detailed data on the **linguistic diversity of India**.
 
• India is home to several language families, including Indo-Aryan, Dravidian, Austroasiatic, and Tibeto-Burman, among others.
 
• Language classification helps in understanding the linguistic landscape and planning for educational and administrative needs.
 
• Efforts are made to preserve and promote all languages spoken in India, reflecting the nation's cultural diversity.
